prompt: Create an original 150 second acoustic swing jazz instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: acoustic guitar, violin, upright bass. Style: crisp rhythmic guitar and playful violin phrases. Tempo approximately 140 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A lively and intricate acoustic guitar piece with a strong folk/Celtic influence. Features a melodic lead guitar over a rhythmic accompaniment, creating a danceable and energetic atmosphere. The tone is bright and clear.
description.zh: 一首活泼而复杂的原声吉他乐曲，带有浓厚的民谣/凯尔特风格。旋律主奏吉他与节奏伴奏相得益彰，营造出舞动而充满活力的氛围。音色明亮清晰。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
